name: Academic Elite
value: Seven awards: four years of tuition, first-year standard housing, and $9,000/year for four years. One top award: tuition, first-year housing, $9,000 in year one, $19,000/year in years two through four, plus a $5,000 research/study allowance.
deadline: December 8, 2026, 11:59 p.m. Central (Witt Fellows application and any endorsement)
apply: Obtain UA admission; apply to the Honors College before or alongside Witt Fellows. Academic Elite is selected from Witt Fellows.
eligibility: Automatic Witt Fellows application eligibility: 3.5 GPA and single-date ACT 32 or SAT 1420. A lower-score endorsement route exists.
notes: Meeting the thresholds does not guarantee the award. Housing is covered for year one only.

name: MAPS
value: Tuition, fees, room and board; twelve awards annually.
apply: Submit the scholarship application, resume and two recommendations; selected applicants interview.
eligibility: Minimum 3.5 high-school GPA and ACT 30 or SAT 1360. Renewal requires 3.25 college GPA and full-time enrollment.
notes: Nonresident scholarship arrangements are described separately and may not stack.

name: Hays Memorial Scholarship
value: Tuition, fees, room and board (confirmed for the Class of 2029 cohort, four recipients).
apply: Recent cohort selection used an essay and group interviews. Current application details not yet published.
notes: Admission dates (EA Nov 15, RD Feb 1) do not establish the scholarship deadline.

name: First-year academic merit (Trustee Scholars unconfirmed)
value: Automatic merit consideration confirmed; an active Trustee full-ride award is not confirmed.
apply: Automatic consideration with admission. Current named awards include Presidential and others.

name: Merit awards (Trustee, Presidential, Mork)

apply: Apply for admission by the merit deadline. No separate Mork application.
eligibility: Admission applicants by the merit deadline.
notes: The older December 1 all-majors deadline is not current for Dornsife.

name: Eugene du Pont Memorial Distinguished Scholar
value: Four years of tuition, standard on-campus room/board, health/student-center fees; $625 each fall and spring for books; one-time $5,000 enrichment grant.

eligibility: No fixed SAT/GPA minimum published. Invitation only.
notes: No public self-application to du Pont.
